title: Raceland band members and who played which instrument
summary: Miller names the roughly eighteen members of the Raceland band and assigns instruments for the interviewer's list.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: And what instruments would those guys play?

Well they had about four trombones, two baritones, two tubas, three altos, and they had two snare drum players, one bass drum. They didn't have no saxophones, and oh that's right, they had two clarinets, but they didn't have no saxophone.
What did Joseph Phillip play?
Joseph Phillip? He played tuba. He played tuba in the big band, you know, but he played guitar and bass violin, and if we played dance, we had an orchestra too, see?
Oh yeah.
Yeah, sure.
How big were these other bands?

What, the orchestra? No, at the different places like Bowie. Oh Bowie, well they had, them fellas had a good large band too. They must have about twelve pieces, and Bowie, the Zelmer had about, I'd say eleven or twelve. All that was a big band.
We might as well get those names and instruments together in Raceland. Who played which instrument?
Oh well, Johnny Hill played trumpet, I played trumpet, Esau Lewis played trumpet, and what are those four trumpets? Johnny, myself, Esau Lewis, and Holly Taylor.
Why don't you put them down? That's right there. Oh that's right.

That's right. And Phillip played tuba and Oscar Shields played tuba. David Lewis on bass drum, Holly Taylor on snare drum. Let me see now, Bluff, his name is Oscar, yeah Oscar, yeah Bluff played alto, Claiborne Royal played alto, and David Lewis played alto. Three alto. Three alto. And Daniel Hadley played crannet and his brother played crannet, Oscar Hadley.
Now what about trombones?
Trombones, get to them now. Yeah. Sullivan Pugh, Joseph Pugh, them was trombone player. Them brothers, Sullivan Pugh and Joseph Pugh.
Did they have one more? How many did you say? Four trombones or three?

No they had three. I'm trying to think this boy would die. Claiborne Royal. Claiborne Royal, he played trombone. That's three, see? They tried to make it three in a row. One row three, another row three, another row three, and another row three. See like that, you know, that's where they reached the parade. They used to parade like two in a line, three in a...
What about baritone horns? Did we name them?

Yeah, I called three baritones. I don't remember. I told you Arthur Dukes, I don't remember. I don't remember. That's right, they had two baritone and an alto walk together. And two altos and a trombone walk together. Arthur Dukes played baritone and Oscar Shields. Oscar Shields.
Yeah, good. That must be it, drums, tubas, trumpets, clarinets.
Two snare drums.
